title: Agent CLI Framework output envelope
description: Every JSON payload a framework CLI writes to stdout or stderr must validate against this schema. The one exception is agent-info, which emits the raw manifest (see agent-info.schema.json).

data.description: Command-specific payload. Object or array; never raw text.

metadata.description: Optional hints about the result that are not the result itself (next steps, truncation, cost). Lets array data carry hints without changing its shape.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. invalid_input, config_error

suggestion.description: Tested recovery instruction an agent can follow literally

details.description: Structured diagnostics or recovery context. Never instructions sourced from untrusted content.

retryable.description: Whether repeating the same request unchanged can succeed. Omit when unknown, e.g. a write whose outcome is uncertain.

retry_after_secs.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when known.
